subject: Materials Science
title: What Is a Polymer?
description: A quick win: understand What Is a Polymer?.

hook.text: A single water molecule is tiny. Chain millions of ethylene units and you get a plastic bag.

buildup.text: Polymers are long chains built by repeating small molecules called monomers.

discovery.text: The word polymer means 'many parts' — thousands of monomers linked end to end.

twist.text: Nature invented polymers first — DNA, silk, and cellulose are all natural polymers.

climax.text: Humans learned to copy nature, and now synthetic polymers touch every part of daily life.

punchline.text: A polymer is one small molecule repeated thousands of times.

quiz.question: What is a polymer made of?
options: Many repeating monomer units linked together
A single large atom of carbon
